coaching.headline: Steady progress, keep the MAF magic! 🚀
coaching.coaching: Today you stayed well within the MAF heart‑rate limit at 149 bpm, which is solid aerobic work. However, your pace of 8:33 /km is outside the target 7:50–8:10 /km range, indicating room to improve speed while keeping HR below 155. Watch the brief spikes to 160 bpm and aim to keep the whole run under the MAF ceiling.
coaching.trend: Your recent runs show consistent HR control (148–154 bpm) but mixed pacing; the 7:40 /km effort on 2026‑09‑28 was the fastest, while slower runs hover around 8:20 /km. Weekly volume is modest at 14 km, which is fine for base building.
coaching.nextRun: Run 10 km at a target pace of 7:55–8:05 /km, keep HR ≤ 154 bpm, and focus on raising cadence to ~180 spm while reducing ground‑contact time toward < 270 ms.
